title: Building Regulations 2010 (England), Approved Documents
disclaimer: An encoded subset of Approved Documents K, M and F for dwellings in ENGLAND only. Approved Documents are guidance, not the regulation itself: compliance can be shown another way. Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland have their own, divergent regulations and this pack does not apply there.

rules.title: Private stair rise
rules.message: The rise is {riser_mm} mm; a private stair is limited to 220 mm.

rules.title: Private stair going
rules.message: The going is {going_mm} mm; a private stair requires at least 220 mm.

rules.title: Private stair pitch
rules.message: The stair pitches at {pitch_degrees}°; a private stair is limited to 42°.

rules.title: Twice the rise plus the going
rules.message: Twice the rise plus the going is {two_r_plus_g} mm; it should fall between 550 and 700 mm.

rules.title: Stair headroom
rules.message: Headroom over the stair is {headroom_mm} mm; 2000 mm is required.

rules.title: Internal doorway clear width
rules.message: A doorway serving {serves} gives {clear_width_mm} mm clear; 750 mm is the minimum where the corridor is at least 1050 mm wide.
rules.note: The required clear width rises as the approach corridor narrows -- 775 mm at 900 mm, 900 mm at 750 mm. Only the most lenient case is checked.

rules.title: Purge ventilation opening area
rules.message: {name} has window area of {glazing_ratio} of its floor area; purge ventilation by an openable window wants at least 1/20th.
rules.note: The requirement is on OPENABLE area, not glazed area. A window whose opening light is half its area needs twice this.
